description: Create a group membership in Zendesk, assigning an agent to a group. Use when you need to add an agent to a specific group for ticket routing, permissions, or team organization. The user_id and group_id are both required parameters. Note: The user must exist and have appropriate permissions to be assigned to groups. The group must also exist.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for creating a group membership in Zendesk.

default.human_parameter_description: Whether this is the default group membership for the agent
default.title: Default

group_id.description: The numeric ID of the group to assign the agent to. You can find this from group list results or ticket group_id fields.

group_id.title: Group Id

user_id.description: The numeric ID of the agent to assign to the group. You can find this from user search results or ticket payloads (requester_id, submitter_id, assignee_id, author_id).
user_id.human_parameter_description: The numeric ID of the agent to assign to the group
user_id.title: User Id
